document.about: Malaria Journal 2009, 8:211 (doi:10.1186/1475-2875-8-211). Its table 2 is not read as a table; its header row sets `95% CI`, `%` and `95%CI` side by side over rows of figures.

notes: #242: the bold column head `95%CI`, level with the other heads of its row over rows of figures, was a heading.

checks.issue: `95%CI`, a column's head over its figures, was an h4.
